title: Big Rip (phantom dark energy)
example_questions: What if dark energy kept getting stronger?
summary: If dark energy has an equation of state w below -1 (phantom energy), its density grows as space expands. The expansion accelerates without limit and in finite time tears apart galaxy clusters, galaxies, solar systems, planets and finally atoms.
support_note: A possible fate if w < -1; current data are consistent with w close to -1, so it is not favoured.
what_happens: About 60 million years before the end the Milky Way is torn apart
About 3 months before, the Solar System comes apart
About 1e-19 s before, atoms are ripped apart

key_numbers.name: Time to the Big Rip for w = -1.5

objections: Phantom energy violates the null energy condition and tends to be unstable

sources.title: Phantom energy and cosmic doomsday
sources.authors: R. R. Caldwell, M. Kamionkowski, N. N. Weinberg
